description: This file defines a CameraCaptureService actor that manages camera device enumeration, image snapping, and video recording on macOS using AVFoundation. It includes error handling, device selection, and media exporting functionalities, along with delegate classes for handling capture callbacks.

classes.name: CameraCaptureService
classes.description: An actor class providing functions for listing camera devices, taking photos, and recording videos on macOS.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their information.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo from the specified camera device with options for facing mode, max width, quality, device ID, and delay.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with options for facing mode, duration, audio inclusion, device ID, and output path.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests media access permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: availableCameras
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices, including external if supported.

methods.name: externalDeviceType
methods.description: Returns the device type for external cameras if available.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects a camera device based on facing mode and device ID.

methods.name: normalizeSnap
methods.description: Normalizes max width and quality values for photo capture.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports a recorded AVAsset to MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: waitForExposureAndWhiteBalance
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until exposure and white balance adjustments are complete.

methods.name: sleepDelayMs
methods.description: Asynchronously delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds.
